items.title: XRP falls 10% as long bets unwind and ETF assets slip below $1 billion
items.teaser: The token broke its previous November lows during Saturday's crypto selloff, with long positions accounting for most XRP liquidations and technical indicators showing further weakness.

items.title: Binance raises RLUSD yield to 6.37% as XRP rewards surge 54%
items.teaser: At the base rate, a steady 10,000 RLUSD balance would have earned 12.72 XRP in the final week, while Binance’s notices leave buying and retention unresolved. Read the full story on CryptoSlate …

items.title: Wagyu’s XMR1 wrapped Monero plunges 99% after $13 million hack as founder promises refunds
items.teaser: Wagyu’s founder pledged refunds after an attacker sold XMR1 Wrapped Monero tokens in a $13 million exploit.

items.title: Hong Kong moves to extend crypto licensing rules to brokers, advisers and custodians
items.teaser: Hong Kong wants to bring crypto brokers, advisers, asset managers and custodians under its existing regulatory framework.

items.title: Live news: Bitcoin slips to fresh lows below $59,000 as Anthropic slides after Nasdaq debut
items.teaser: BlackRock’s bitcoin ETF saw a record $541.1 million outflow as the U.S. tech selloff spread to Asia, sending South Korea’s Kospi down more than 5%.

items.title: Coinbase targets first-half 2027 for its own prediction market contracts
items.teaser: The move would reduce Coinbase's reliance on a partnership Kalshi, which brought in $200 million in annualized revenue in the third quarter.

items.title: MoonPay applies for national trust bank charter to expand stablecoin services
items.teaser: MoonPay has applied for a national trust bank charter to expand its custody and stablecoin services under federal oversight.

items.title: U.S. Senate passes bill to ban prediction market bets on war and death
items.teaser: The bill would ban bets on war, assassinations and military operations amid concerns that traders could profit from inside information, as has already occurred.

items.title: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest piled into Anthropic IPO, buying $90 million worth of shares
items.teaser: ARK Invest snapped up $90 million in Anthropic stock across six funds during the AI maker’s historic Nasdaq debut while offloading Nvidia shares amid leadership turmoil.

items.title: CFTC Chair on Hyperliquid and onchain venues, Ripple CLO doubts Elizabeth Warren will set crypto policy, and more
items.teaser: In today's newsletter, CFTC Chair Selig outlines how Hyperliquid and other onchain venues could enter the US; Ripple's Alderoty doubts Elizabeth Warren will set US crypto policy; and more.
